comment: Mock data for tools/mock_plasmaard.py, captured read-only from a real plasmaard (MX Master 4 + K850 + MX Anywhere 3S) and kglobalaccel on 2026-10-03.

settings.name: hires-smooth-invert
settings.label: Scroll Wheel Direction
settings.description: Invert direction for vertical scroll with wheel.

settings.name: hires-smooth-resolution
settings.label: Scroll Wheel Resolution
settings.description:
High-sensitivity mode for vertical scroll with the wheel.
Set to ignore if scrolling is abnormally fast or slow

settings.name: hires-scroll-mode
settings.label: Scroll Wheel Diversion
settings.description: Make scroll wheel send HIRES_WHEEL HID++ notifications (which trigger Solaar rules but are otherwise ignored).

settings.name: scroll-ratchet-torque
settings.label: Scroll Wheel Ratchet Torque
settings.description: Change the torque needed to overcome the ratchet.

settings.name: scroll-ratchet
settings.label: Scroll Wheel Ratcheted
settings.description: Switch the mouse wheel between speed-controlled ratcheting and always freespin.

settings.name: smart-shift
settings.label: Scroll Wheel Ratchet Speed
settings.description:
Use the mouse wheel speed to switch between ratcheted and freespinning.
The mouse wheel is always ratcheted at 50.

settings.name: thumb-scroll-invert
settings.label: Thumb Wheel Direction
settings.description: Invert thumb wheel scroll direction.

settings.name: thumb-scroll-mode
settings.label: Thumb Wheel Diversion
settings.description: Make thumb wheel send THUMB_WHEEL HID++ notifications (which trigger Solaar rules but are otherwise ignored).

settings.name: dpi
settings.label: Sensitivity (DPI)
settings.description:
Mouse movement sensitivity
May need Onboard Profiles set to Disable to be effective.

settings.name: reprogrammable-keys
settings.label: Key/Button Actions
settings.description:
Change the action for the key or button.  Overridden by diversion.
Changing important actions (such as for the left mouse button) can result in an unusable system.

settings.name: divert-keys
settings.label: Key/Button Diversion
settings.description: Make the key or button send HID++ notifications (Diverted) or initiate Mouse Gestures or Sliding DPI

settings.name: force-sensing
settings.label: Force Sensing Button
settings.description: Change the force required to activate button.

settings.name: change-host
settings.label: Change Host
settings.description: Switch connection to a different host

settings.name: haptic-level
settings.label: Haptic Feedback Level
settings.description: Change power of haptic feedback.  (Zero to turn off.)

settings.name: haptic-play
settings.label: Play Haptic Waveform
settings.description: Tell device to play a haptic waveform.

settings.name: fn-swap
settings.label: Swap Fx function
settings.description:
When set, the F1..F12 keys will activate their special function,
and you must hold the FN key to activate their standard function.

When unset, the F1..F12 keys will activate their standard function,
and you must hold the FN key to activate their special function.

settings.name: persistent-remappable-keys
settings.label: Persistent Key/Button Mapping
settings.description:
Permanently change the mapping for the key or button.
Changing important keys or buttons (such as for the left mouse button) can result in an unusable system.

settings.name: divert-keys
settings.label: Key/Button Diversion
settings.description: Make the key or button send HID++ notifications (Diverted) or initiate Mouse Gestures or Sliding DPI

settings.name: disable-keyboard-keys

settings.description: Disable specific keyboard keys.
